swingContinuity: 최근 며칠간 QQQ의 매수점수가 51~56 구간에서 횡보하다 9월14일(월, 뉴욕) 59로 소폭 개선되었습니다. 다만, 최근 5거래일 QQQ는 -0.08%에서 -1.06%까지 하락세를 보이다가 +0.87% 반등 후 다시 -0.53% 하락하며 변동성을 키우는 흐름입니다. 특히 SOXX와 NVDA가 각각 -5.09%, -2.82%로 큰 폭 하락하며 반도체 섹터의 약세가 두드러졌습니다.
swingContinuityEn: QQQ's buy score, which had been ranging between 51 and 56 in recent days, saw a slight improvement to 59 today. However, QQQ's trend over the last 5 trading days showed a pattern of decline from -0.08% to -1.06%, followed by a rebound of +0.87%, and then another drop to -0.53%, indicating increasing volatility. Notably, the semiconductor sector exhibited significant weakness, with SOXX and NVDA falling sharply by -5.09% and -2.82% respectively.
